packetName: Mark 9 Controlled TMM Feed Implementation and Content Seeding
purpose: Documents the controlled, static, build-time TMM editorial index now rendered at /media: a local content collection seeded with exactly three structural placeholder records, rendered through new Astro components with a strict, multi-condition gate on any future outbound link. This is a public-rendering implementation pass, not a production release, API integration, account-verification, or conversion pass. No real media has been verified, linked, embedded, published, or ingested.

partB_collectionSchema.location: src/lib/media-schema.ts (zod schema) + src/content.config.ts (defineCollection, glob loader) + src/content/media/*.json (data)
partB_collectionSchema.loader: astro/loaders glob({ pattern: '**/*.json', base: './src/content/media' }) -- reads local files only, at build time only. No network request of any kind.

fields.type: string (never rendered on the public page)

stateProgressionExplicitDifference.placeholder: The default, structural-only state every field starts at. No real evidence exists yet. This is what all three seeded records use for every status field.
stateProgressionExplicitDifference.ownerSupplied: The owner has entered a specific value (e.g. a canonicalUrl) -- this alone does NOT make it publicly linkable; it only means the field is no longer blank.
stateProgressionExplicitDifference.internallyReviewed: An editorial/rights/accessibility/claims reviewer has checked the owner-supplied value against docs/internal/mark-8-tmm-source-verification-checklist.md and docs/internal/mark-8-tmm-unified-media-feed-architecture.md gates G-M1-G-M8.
stateProgressionExplicitDifference.futureApprovedStaticIndex: The terminal state (status/editorialStatus/ownerApprovalStatus/publicDisplayStatus all reaching their strongest value) required before MediaCard.astro's link-rendering gate can ever be satisfied for that record.

partB_collectionSchema.explicitProhibitionOnAssumedAdvancement: No record's status field may be changed from its current value based on inference, familiarity, prior mention elsewhere, or assumption. Every status change requires the specific evidence artifact that status value represents, per docs/internal/mark-9-media-placeholder-owner-update-guide.md.

partC_publicRenderingRules.conditionsForRenderingNoLink: Default. Any record where linkMode is 'no-link' (all three seeded records) renders no anchor element, no button, and no clickable surface for its source destination.
conditionsRequiredForFutureStaticExterna: canonicalUrl is a syntactically valid http(s) URL (checked defensively in MediaCard.astro via the URL constructor)
partC_publicRenderingRules.conditionsRequiredForFutureInternalDetai: Not built or authorized in this pass. MediaCard.astro's own code comment states a card may use an internal link only if an actual approved /media/[slug]-equivalent route exists -- none does.
partC_publicRenderingRules.conditionsRequiredForFutureEmbedConsider: Not built or authorized in this pass -- see docs/internal/mark-8-tmm-unified-media-feed-architecture.json partC_futureFeedModes, Mode 3 (Approved embed mode), none of whose prerequisites have been met.
partC_publicRenderingRules.explicitProhibitionOnApiRssAutomation: No API call, RSS fetcher, webhook, OAuth flow, or any other automatic ingestion mechanism exists anywhere in this implementation. The loader used (astro/loaders glob) reads only local files already committed to this repository at build time.

partD_placeholderInventory.whyNoExternalUrlDateImageMetricEmbedOrCt: No owner-supplied evidence exists yet for this record's ownership, rights, publication date, or content -- rendering any of those without evidence would misrepresent an unverified assertion as a fact

Same as above, plus: founder-associated media is never automatically TMI/TMM content per docs/internal/mark-8-tmm-unified-media-feed-architecture.md Part B -- this record's crossAttributionStatus stays 'prohibited-pending-per-item-approval'
